title: About Tricore IT Solutions
content: Tricore IT Solutions is an online store for IT products. Customers browse the shop, choose a product, enter their delivery address and place the order; the item is reserved for them. Every order opens a support ticket automatically, and the Tricore team uses that ticket to confirm the order and arrange payment and delivery with the customer. Once the team confirms payment the order is shipped, and every step including the courier name and tracking number appears under My orders. Product categories are Laptops and Desktops, Networking, Servers and Storage, Security and CCTV, Peripherals, and Software and Licenses. Exact products, prices and stock available now are in the PRODUCTS section of the context.

title: How ordering works
content: Step 1: Sign in with your Google account and open the Shop. Step 2: Click Buy on a product, which opens the checkout page. Step 3: Enter your delivery address (name, phone number, PIN code and address) and tap Place order; the item is reserved for you and the total is shown. Step 4: A support ticket is opened automatically for the order and the team contacts you on it to confirm the order and arrange payment and delivery. Step 5: Once the team receives your payment the order moves to Payment received and is prepared for shipping. Step 6: The courier name and tracking number appear under My orders. Step 7: The order is marked delivered. The assistant can start an order for you, but the address and payment are completed on the checkout page and in the support ticket.

title: How payment works
content: The Tricore team arranges payment with each customer personally; the website does not take payment on its own. After an order is placed the item is reserved and a support ticket is opened. The team replies on that ticket with the exact amount and how to pay, confirms it when the money arrives, and then the order is shipped. Until then the order shows as Awaiting payment, and while it does the customer can cancel it under My orders. The assistant must never name, recommend or invent any payment app, wallet, card, gateway, bank account, UPI ID, QR code, payment link or extra charge, and must never change an amount or a deadline. Asked how to pay before the team has replied, it says the team will confirm the payment details on that order's support ticket and offers to connect the customer with the team now.

title: Prices, special deals and the Tricore team
content: The assistant cannot change prices, give discounts or coupons, approve special or bulk deals, or create custom quotes. If a customer wants a lower price or a special deal, it explains that it cannot do that itself and asks whether the customer would like to be connected with the Tricore team. Each order is confirmed by the team through its support ticket, and that ticket is where payment is arranged. Exact delivery times, shipping charges, returns and warranty terms are not in the knowledge base, so the assistant must say honestly that it does not have them on hand, must not guess, and may offer to connect the customer with the team.

title: Signing in and creating an account
content: Tricore uses Google sign-in only. There is no separate password. New customers create their account by clicking Sign up with Google, and returning customers click Sign in with Google. You must be signed in to open the Shop and to see your orders. The landing page and this assistant are available without signing in.

title: Order status meanings
content: After signing in, customers can see all their orders under My orders with a step-by-step progress bar. Awaiting payment means the order is placed, the item is reserved, and the team will contact you on the order's support ticket to arrange payment; you can cancel the order yourself while it is in this state. Payment received means the team has confirmed your payment and the order is being prepared. Shipped means the order was dispatched and the courier name and tracking number are shown. Delivered means the order reached you. Cancelled means you cancelled it, the team cancelled it, or it passed the unpaid-order time limit, and the item went back into stock. A few older orders may also show Payment submitted, where the team was checking a payment reference the customer sent.

title: Products, prices and availability
content: Products, prices and availability are shown in the Shop and in the PRODUCTS section of the context. Prices are in Indian rupees. A product marked out of stock cannot be ordered. Low stock means only a few units are left. The item is reserved when an order is placed and goes back into stock if the order is cancelled.
